description: This Java source file defines a 'Filter' class used for pattern matching to include or exclude strings based on full or prefix patterns. It is part of the 'com.android.mkstubs' package and provides methods to retrieve pattern sets and determine if a string passes the filter criteria.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A class that manages include and exclude patterns for string filtering, supporting full and prefix pattern matching.

methods.name: getIncludeFull
methods.description: Returns the set of all full patterns to be included.

methods.name: getIncludePrefix
methods.description: Returns the set of all prefix patterns to be included.

methods.name: getExcludeFull
methods.description: Returns the set of all full patterns to be excluded.

methods.name: getExcludePrefix
methods.description: Returns the set of all prefix patterns to be excluded.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines if a given string passes the include/exclude pattern rules based on full and prefix matches.
